<noinclude>{{DISPLAYTITLE:List of ''Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire'' episodes}}
This is a list of episodes of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'', which first aired between November 21, 2002 and September 14, 2006 in Japan and between November 1, 2003 and March 3, 2007 in {{pmin|the United States}}, though the first two episodes were aired as a sneak peek on March 15, 2003. These episodes follow [[Ash Ketchum]] in his [[Pokémon journey]] across the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], as well as his foray into [[Kanto]]'s {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. He is joined by his longtime friend {{an|Brock}}, as well as rookie {{pkmn|Coordinator}} {{an|May}} and her brother [[Max]].
__TOC__</noinclude>
